title: High-Frequency Exponential-Utility Maximization under Fractional Brownian Motion
abstract: arXiv:2608.05357v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study utility maximization for high-frequency trading in fractional Brownian motion models. We first consider exponential utility in the discretized arithmetic model. Using spectral methods for stationary Gaussian sequences, we derive the asymptotic growth rate of the optimal certainty equivalent and the scaling limit of the optimal positions. We then consider power and logarithmic utility in a positive-price model with positive wealth and investment fractions in $[0,1]$. In this case, the logarithm of the optimal certainty equivalent grows at rate $n^{1-H}$ for $H\neq1/2$, with a coefficient determined by the one-sided prediction error of fractional Gaussian noise. We also give a simple binary strategy which attains this leading rate, without claiming exact finite-horizon optimality.

translated_title: 分数布朗运动下的高频指数效用最大化
translated_abstract: 我们研究分数布朗运动模型中高频交易的效用最大化问题。我们首先考虑离散化算术模型中的指数效用，利用平稳高斯序列的谱方法，推导出最优确定性等价的渐近增长率以及最优头寸的标度极限。随后，我们在一个价格为正、财富为正且投资比例限制在[0,1]区间内的正价格模型中考虑幂效用和对数效用。在这种情况下，当H≠1/2时，最优确定性等价的对数以n^{1-H}的速率增长，其系数由分数高斯噪声的单侧预测误差决定。我们还给出了一个能达到该主导增长率的简单二元策略，但并不声称其在有限期限内是精确最优的。
tldr: 该论文利用平稳高斯序列的谱方法，研究了分数布朗运动模型下高频交易的效用最大化问题，推导出最优确定性等价以n^{1-H}速率的渐近增长，并构造了一个简单二元策略即可达到该主导增长率。
en_tdlr: Using spectral methods for stationary Gaussian sequences, this paper derives the n^{1-H} asymptotic growth rate of the optimal certainty equivalent for high-frequency utility maximization under fractional Brownian motion, and provides a simple binary strategy that attains this leading rate.
